description: Heat flood insurance and housing risk can be reframed from emergency response to shared habitat and climate justice.
AI in public systems can be framed as innovation race public infrastructure civic trust or automated control.
Trust fragmentation can be reframed from communication failure to legitimacy repair and accountable public relationship.
Education futures can be reframed from workforce pipeline to learning commons civic capacity and human formation.
Urban resource stress can be reframed from supply management to regional living systems and ecological responsibility.
Care stress can be reframed from labor shortage to social reproduction public health and dignity infrastructure.
